title: Evidence-grounded homework generation and validation
goal: Compose a usable homework draft from learner evidence and reviewed material.
rationale: Generation should serve the teaching need while preserving objective, provenance and correctness.
scope: Initial concise draft; specification only, no implementation or acceptance claimed. Homework only. Sources: PD-09/10/12–17/35/37; Architecture sections 2/7. Lesson planning, urgent replanning and unrelated original exercise authoring are excluded.

depends_on.reason: Needs eligible reviewed material and provenance.

requirement.title: Evidence-grounded homework generation and validation
requirement.statement: Use both lesson and homework evidence to select explained objectives, then reuse/adapt reviewed assets and compose timed homework. Adapt preferred domains without silently relaxing hard requirements. Keep student content separate from the tutor guide and block safety, validity or unsupported-fact failures.

scenarios.given: A tutor requests homework with learner evidence, eligible assets and a duration.
scenarios.when: The workflow prepares and validates a draft.
scenarios.then: The draft explains its objectives, fits the planned duration, preserves sources and provides separate student instructions and a tutor guide.
scenarios.verification: Future complete preparation observation with reviewed inputs and tutor rubric.

scenarios.given: An adaptation has a wrong/ambiguous answer, unsupported learner claim or unmet hard requirement.
scenarios.then: The affected material requires correction/removal and cannot become an approved ready artifact.
scenarios.verification: Future seeded-defect cases through the actual validation boundary.

scenarios.given: No eligible reviewed asset can meet a required objective.
scenarios.then: It exposes the gap or a useful tutor choice instead of inventing an exercise/reference or silently changing the objective.

tasks.description: Produce evidence-linked objectives and source-preserving homework adaptations.
Compose separate student/tutor content and apply part/plan validation gates.
